 By Sneha Kulkarni , ET Online Last Updated: Nov 03, 2026, 05:50:20 PM IST Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis
 Gold rates tpday: Gold prices for 22k jewellery have increased across major brands in India as Dhanteras approaches. while, gold and silver jewellery indicative prices at the India Bullion and Jewellers Association (IBJA) also increased today. Listen to this article in summarized format
 Listen ET Online Gold rate today: 24k vs 22k vs 20k vs 18k prices Gold prices increased marginally today (Tuesday, November 3, 2026) across key jewellery brands such as Joyaukkas, Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Tanishq and Kalyan Jewellers ahead of Dhanteras and Diwali, a period when many households traditionally buy gold jewellery, coins and other precious metal items. Gold jewellery indicative prices at the India Bullion and Jewellers Association (IBJA) also increased today while, silver prices decreased.
With Dhanteras and Diwali around the corner, many buyers track daily gold and silver price movements before making a purchase.
 Gold-silver outlook
Prithviraj Kothari, Managing Director at RiddiSiddhi Bullions Ltd., President of IBJA says "Gold and silver have rebounded from last week’s lows as a more than 7% drop in oil eased inflation concerns. Markets now await the US midterm results, where a Democratic sweep could weigh on the tech trade and drag gold into selling as investors cover losses. Iran and the US are still talking about ending their eight-month war, though Qatari-mediated talks brought no breakthrough. The WGC expects India’s gold demand to hit a six-year low in 2026. Gold met its $3900 (~Rs 138,000) target and silver its $50 (~Rs 180,000); a break below last week’s low could trigger further selling." 
Kaynat Chainwala, AVP Commodity Research, Kotak Neo says, "Spot gold slipped below $3,900/oz today, while spot silver hit a fresh one-year low of $48.5/oz, as renewed gains in oil prices rekindled inflation concerns and reinforced expectations that U.S. interest rates could remain higher for longer. Investors also remained cautious ahead of the U.S. midterm elections, which could have significant implications for energy policy and Washington's approach towards Iran. The decline follows a brief rebound yesterday, when gold rose nearly 2% and silver gained more than 3% amid reports of progress in U.S.-Iran negotiations, which weighed on crude oil and eased inflation concerns."
 Gold and silver rates today (Tuesday, November 3, 2026)
Here is a look at today’s 22k gold jewellery rates from Tanishq, Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Kalyan Jewellers and Joyalukkas across Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Trivandrum.
